Subject: [PATCH 0/1] Tickets: 2 from another store

This is a git-ticket export: one or more tickets, and the patches that
carry them.

    git am *.patch

Nothing here needs git-ticket. The patches add ordinary Markdown files, so
a repository that runs git-ticket gains real tickets and one that does not
gains readable text in a directory.

This file is not part of the series. It is named .txt so the glob above
skips it, since a cover letter has no diff to apply.

Numbers 0 and 1 are this export's. A sender attaching code uses
`git format-patch --start-number 2 -o <this directory> <range>`, and the
one command above still applies the whole of it.

TKT-01K3ZZ67Q0PT427VFD1F4WFWSH  [spike, blocked, normal]

Can the daemon survive a provider outage

## Description

Status `blocked`, type `spike`.

## Notes

Blocked 2026-09-02: the staging provider account is suspended, so there is no
way to produce the outage this spike has to observe.

This is the pair 6.2 requires. `status_reason` carries the current reason, which
a query can read back, and this note carries the history, which survives the
transition that clears the field.
